title: Audio input accumulating read loop
summary: Recovered free cdecl reader at VA 0x58d880: repeatedly invokes +0x6d58, advances destination, accumulates positive results, conditionally accounts position at +0x6d44 using post-callback flag 8, stops on zero and normalizes negatives to -1. Preserves unchecked oversized results and wrapping 32-bit arithmetic. Direct original disassembly confirms accepted instructions; setup installs this callback at +0x6d78.
test_description: 504 differential cases plus null nonpositive early exits against original cdecl reference at its original VA. Negative/zero/positive/INT_MAX requests; immediate zero and negative results including INT_MIN; partial reads, partial then error, completion, oversized results and signed accumulator wrap; position wrap; flag 8 enabled/disabled and unrelated bits; callback mutates flags, position, opaque bytes and callback slot. Compares return, callback order/destination/remaining/count/state observations, complete state image and guarded destination bytes. Explicit FS setup and head restoration checks after every original call. Locally passed GCC fixed-flag freestanding execution; accepted reference verified equal to all 83 original bytes. Implementation also compiled with pinned MSVC2013 under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Callbacks are controlled test functions; audio backend, dispatcher and installed-callback consumers are outside scope.
No validation of null callbacks or invalid writable buffers on positive-count paths; the original performs none.
Overlarge-result tests use opaque non-dereferenced 32-bit addresses; memory safety is a caller/backend contract. Infinite positive callback sequences after arithmetic wrap are not run.
Original field offsets and address wrap apply to the 32-bit ABI; native 64-bit pointer arithmetic follows native address width.
No matching-byte credit claimed; opaque field meanings and full state extent remain unresolved.
